name: Jump Rope Double-Under
steps: Stand tall with feet together, elbows tucked close to your ribs, and hold a speed rope behind your heels.
Jump slightly higher than a standard single jump while keeping your body straight and legs together.
Flick both wrists rapidly twice in midair so the rope passes cleanly beneath your feet twice before landing.
Land lightly on the balls of your feet and rebound smoothly straight into the next jump.
tips: Spin the rope with quick wrists rather than swinging wide circles from your shoulders.
Keep your body tall and straight in the air instead of kicking your heels back or piking forward.
